failure_modes.mode: Collapsed navigation loses labels or becomes inaccessible
failure_modes.cause: CSS-only concealment and missing state/focus semantics
failure_modes.detection: Keyboard, persistence and desktop/mobile browser checks
failure_modes.mitigation: Semantic toggle, accessible labels, tooltips, persistent preference and independent mobile layout

failure_modes.mode: AI interprets criteria or courses as candidate employment evidence
failure_modes.cause: Mixed job/CV/context blocks and hardcoded credential examples
failure_modes.mitigation: Separate person specification, reviewed criterion evidence, user-confirmed source types and exact credential names

failure_modes.mode: Preview displays saved searches instead of current controls
failure_modes.detection: Browser tests comparing displayed effective queries and budgets
failure_modes.mitigation: Debounced current-control preview with stale/request protection

failure_modes.mode: Guidance overstates sponsorship or NHS AI policy
failure_modes.cause: Generalizing across visa routes and employers
failure_modes.mitigation: Dated sources, separate eligibility from statement merit, no universal sponsorship/AI-policy assumptions
